result.question: What does the man of God do after speaking?

readings.answer: He went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
readings.support: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

assessments.reason: Verse 10 states, “So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel,” which matches the key’s idea of returning by a different route.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says he went another way and did not return by his original route, aligning with “returns home a different way.”
